notes:
Summary: mid-market customer building a contact-center-first AI layer for support agents and L2 workflows. Primary ask: high-confidence RAG over multiple knowledge sources (Zendesk, Confluence, S3 attachments, product release notes) with explicit citations and freshness controls. Team is very sensitive to hallucinations — wants provenance, timestamped citations, and deterministic fallback to authoritative articles.

Requirements (explicit):
- Agent assist latency target: P95 < 350ms for single-turn suggestions (must evaluate end-to-end including retrieval).
- Spike tolerance: expected 5x traffic during launches and incident storms; need autoscale and graceful degradation (fall back to smaller model or cached answers).
- Retrieval: multi-source vector store + hybrid retrieval (sparse BM25 + dense re-rank). Freshness window: 24–72h for KBs, immediate for release notes.
- Citations: inline source refs + link back to Zendesk article + confidence score. Must surface passage offsets for auditability.
- Security/compliance: customer data residency for EU customers, SSO/SAML, full audit logs, KMS integration for keys.
- Operational: want token-level cost telemetry, per-route SLOs, canary rollouts for model changes.

CRM-style notes from calls: 
- "If the model hallucinates and cites wrong article we will fail SOC audit" — security lead (I. Martinez).
- AE: Maya T. did discovery, SE kickoff with Ravi on 2025-12-05.
- SE feedback: prototype needs deterministic retrieval ID with TTL and de-dup across Confluence + Zendesk.
- Product team: prefer not to have full on-prem; open to VPC-private for EU regs + on-prem binder for air-gapped high-security customers.
- Cost sensitivity: primary engineering org worried about token spend for L2 summarization; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization + batching).

Stubs/links: pricing deck + security FAQ shared in drive. Fireflies meeting IDs for technical deep-dive and security review included below.

Short take: strong fit for Redwood Dedicated/Private with Optimize addon. POC must prove RAG provenance & spike handling to clear procurement.
